title: MonsterScaler
description: MonsterScaler adds dynamic difficulty to your server! Monsters level up based on time/distance, gaining boosted stats, enchanted gear, unique debuffs, and triggering server-wide events like Blood Moons and Invasions.
body:
חחחח יצאתי גנוב, צודק לגמרי! הנה התיאור המלא והמקצועי באנגלית, מעוצב ומנוסח בול לסגנון של SpigotMC, BuiltByBit (Mc-Market) או Modrinth.

בלי חפירות ובלי מערכת הפרסים הישנה — נטו הליבה הקשוחה של הפלאגין.

🛡️ MonsterScaler — The Ultimate Dynamic Difficulty Engine
MonsterScaler takes your server's survival experience to the next level. Tired of vanilla monsters becoming a total joke once players get diamond or netherite gear? This plugin ensures your world stays dangerous, challenging, and engaging by dynamically scaling mob stats based on time, distance, and custom world events!

As monsters level up, they gain increased health, custom damage attributes, superior enchanted equipment, and tactical combat abilities. Best of all? It's optimized to run flawlessly with zero performance impact (Lag-Free).

🚀 Core Features
📈 Dual-Scaling Level System:

Time-Based Scaling: The global monster difficulty tier automatically increments every X minutes (fully customizable in the config).

Distance-Based Scaling: The further players venture from the world spawn point (0,0), the higher the level and danger of the monsters they encounter.

👑 Elite / Champion Variants:
Monsters have a configurable chance to spawn as powerful Elite Bosses with massively boosted health bars, devastating attack damage, and a distinct prefix display.

💥 Brood Splitting Mechanism:
When an Elite monster is slain, it has a chance to explode and fragment into multiple fast-moving, aggressive Minions to keep players on their toes.

⚔️ Dynamic Equipment & Enchantment Overrides:
High-level mobs won't spawn empty-handed. They will automatically equip higher tier armor and weapons (Iron/Diamond) enshrouded with random combat enchantments scaling with their level.

🔥 Sunlight Burn Immunity:
Powerful undead monsters evolve past their natural weaknesses. Once they hit a specific level, they become immune to burning during daylight hours.

🛡️ Built-in Thorns Reflection:
Monsters above a certain level threshold reflect a percentage of incoming melee damage directly back at the attacker (fully customizable cap limit).

☣️ Tactical Combat Debuffs:

Zombies: A chance to inflict blindness or intense hunger upon striking a player.

Skeletons: A chance to fire custom utility arrows tipped with Poison or Flame.

🌙 Global World Events
🩸 Blood Moon:
A terrifying nightly event that has a random chance to trigger. When the Blood Moon rises, all monsters receive a significant level boost, terrifying stat mutations, and a global chat broadcast sounds the alarm.

⚔️ Invasion / Raid Mode:
An admin-triggered event that forcefully boosts all regional monsters to an aggressive state, transforming the world into a brutal warzone.

💻 Commands & Permissions
/ms bloodmoon — Manually toggle the Blood Moon event on or off.

/ms invasion — Manually toggle the server-wide Invasion event.

/ms reload — Reloads the configuration file instantly without restarting the server.

🔑 Admin Permission Node: monsterscaler.admin

🛠️ Clean & Clean Config (config.yml)
The plugin generates a highly detailed configuration file allowing you to tweak every single detail: from exact percentage stat gains per level, custom tracking ranges (Follow Range), to highly customizable chat messages and nametag templates (Nametag Format).
